description: Read or change who drives a desktop capsule's shared screen. state 'free' (nobody), 'agent' (you; every input renews a 45 s hold) or 'human' (a person; your input is refused until they hand it back). action 'status' (default) reads it, 'take' claims it for you, 'release' lets go when you finish so the person can use the screen, 'pace' sets how your input plays while a person watches: 'natural' (the pointer glides, typing is readable) or 'presentation' (slow enough to follow every step); 'fast' is the default. action 'visible' turns visible mode on or off (when the person asks to see every step). The status says visible: true while it is on: then do every step on the screen instead of through commands. action 'care' sets how carefully you check your work: 'quick', 'balanced' (the default) or 'careful'; the status says care when it is not balanced.

note.description: Optional note shown on the console
